Hello Jonah
Im always fully transparent so there is no confusion and informed decisions are made from the get-go.

Digerati Investments VC fund only considers (not guaranteed) backing founders they have first worked with in some capacity through Reciprocity ROI Capital Management studio.

Why?

Reciprocity ROI capital management, diligence & syndications studio is to determine issuer and allocator alignment and responsible capital deployment through appropriate compliance and diligence which the startup must participate in.
We can’t determine that through phone calls and bit of paperwork

Additionally, any investor worth being on your cap table should also be bringing coinvestors with them.
We 100% own vouching for you to our coinvestors.
We cannot authentically do that if we have not personally had a front seat to how you operate & execute.
At this stage it is not about the product, it
